triage.desk_query: Term sheet G01 states the barrier twice and consistently: "Knock-in Level of 65 per cent. of the Initial Level." and "European (Final Valuation Date only); 65 per cent. of the Initial Level". The booking record carries barrier_level_pct = 70. Please confirm whether the booking should be amended to 65, or identify the executed document version or amendment that supports a 70 per cent knock-in level.
triage.cited_clause: Knock-in Level of 65 per cent. of the Initial Level.
triage.rationale: Both extractors agree and two independent spans in the term sheet unambiguously state 65 per cent, so the divergent booking value is the more likely error.
